detection_modes.strict: IMPORT line, same-line LOAD shape (import_module/spec_from_file_location/__import__/runpy/subprocess/exec/'python') or a call to one of the 75 live helper loaders (e.g. load_legacy(...)), or an operator-surface text reference (.claude/commands, .github/workflows, CLAUDE.md, pyproject.toml, README.md)

law: Unknown stays blocked. Similar naming is not successor proof. No classification here authorizes deletion, archive moves, shell retirement, .gitignore edits or runtime cleanup.

rules.R-ARCHIVE-FAMILY-NO-STRICT-CONSUMER: accepted R1 master-plan archive destination AND no strict live consumer -> ARCHIVE_PRESERVE (not executable until prerequisites; D1 proves guards change)
rules.R-CONSERVATIVE-ONLY-CONSUMER: no strict consumer but an unresolved conservative string/loader reference, no archive destination -> BLOCKED_UNKNOWN
rules.R-DELETE-SAFE-ALL-CRITERIA: all eight T criteria evidenced (validator-enforced; see NC10)
rules.R-DOC-STUB: docs/ stub over archive/routing body; registry population member -> COMPATIBILITY_SHELL_KEEP
rules.R-LIVE-CONSUMER: strict live consumer (direct, transitive through experiments/**, operator surface, or frozen AQ4 surface) without a shell marker -> BLOCKED_LIVE_CONSUMER
rules.R-NO-FAMILY-NO-SUCCESSOR: no consumer found, no accepted destination/successor -> BLOCKED_UNKNOWN (absence is not deletion evidence)
rules.R-OPERATOR-SHELL-NO-CALLERS: declared shell marker, no archive destination, no live caller -> COMPATIBILITY_SHELL_KEEP
rules.R-OVR-POLICY-BOUNDARY / R-OVR-LIVE-PRODU: named overrides with recorded evidence; all resolve to BLOCKED_LIVE_CONSUMER
rules.R-SHELL-WITH-LIVE-CALLERS: strict live consumer AND a declared delegation/shell marker line -> COMPATIBILITY_SHELL_KEEP
rules.R-TOMBSTONE: halt-loud tombstone executed/pinned by a guard -> COMPATIBILITY_SHELL_KEEP
